entry.title: New: dsh-deepseek-pet
entry.summary: Animated DeepSeek blue-whale desktop pet floating on the DSH Web page: draggable with speech bubbles and mood poses, a pet_say tool for the model to make it talk, and turn-start/end thinking and celebrating states. Exact install spec: github:txlznbzsdj-collab/dsh-deepseek-pet. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
